label: INTERACTIVE_SESSIONS
argv: ( for n in 26799 27105; do echo PID=$n; test -d /proc/$n || continue; cat /proc/$n/stat; cat /proc/$n/status; printf "wchan="; cat /proc/$n/wchan; echo; ls -l /proc/$n/fd/0 /proc/$n/fd/1 /proc/$n/fd/2; done; ps -ef ); rc=$?; printf '\nRC=%s\n' "$rc"; if [ "$rc" -eq 0 ]; then echo DONE_INTERACTIVE_SESSIONS; else echo FAIL_INTERACTIVE_SESSIONS; fi
